items.title: Architecture, contracts, repository and CI
items.scope: Neutral TypeScript contracts, CI, four-repository plans, E2EESA pinned baseline and documented trust boundaries. No consumer branding or reward economics in core.
items.acceptance: Typecheck, core boundary/static checks, roadmap dependency validation, build and contract tests pass. Every release and field state remains separately reported.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.title: Device and acoustics feasibility harness
items.scope: Record reference captures, device routes, timing, calibration uncertainty and failures without treating test data as field evidence.
items.acceptance: Simulations never enable a hardware compatibility or verified-volume claim.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.title: Identity, tenants and scoped roles
items.scope: Scoped capabilities and endpoint-controlled enrollment/revocation. Tenant, application, device and operation isolation; separate service login from E2EE recipient authority. Authentication and durable persistence are adapters.
items.acceptance: Cross-tenant/application, expired capabilities, forged enrollment, rollback, reused devices and revoked authorizers are rejected. External identity provisioning is explicitly separate.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.title: Secure asset ingestion
items.scope: Resumable ciphertext-only ingestion, quotas, checksums, idempotency, expiry and quarantine. Probe/transcode at authorized endpoints; storage never receives a private manifest or key.
items.acceptance: Interrupted ciphertext transfers resume; digest mismatch, oversized upload, mixed tenant/application and mutated duplicate chunks fail closed. No server plaintext processing.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.title: Rights and permitted-use records
items.scope: Evaluate explicit permissions for playback, distribution, caching, rewards and spatial use.
items.acceptance: Absent, revoked, expired or geographically incompatible permissions deny new delivery.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.title: Media packaging and loudness metadata
items.scope: Authorized-endpoint media packaging, sample counts/alignment, waveform and peak/loudness metadata, bounded gain and independent encryption of renditions. Codec/transcoder plugins never run inside ciphertext-only relays.
items.acceptance: Known PCM fixtures validate duration, peaks, alignment, clipping and encrypted package integrity. Unsupported codecs or measurement configurations fail closed; no LUFS claim from peak measurements.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.title: Canonical generic audio timeline
items.scope: Deterministic neutral asset timeline, epochs, revisions, loops, fallback clips and future-effective publication. Generic transition markers; radio show/song/outro and reward semantics belong to Distributed Radio Engine.
items.acceptance: Join times resolve identical clip/sample targets. Revisions switch atomically at agreed boundaries without duplicate/omitted content; no consumer dependency.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.title: Encrypted delivery and broad-compatibility adapter
items.scope: Ciphertext segment transport, cache adapters, endpoint decryption and playback clock integration. Browser interoperability is a playback claim; tighter acoustic synchronization needs separate qualification.
items.acceptance: Route and transport errors do not imply acoustic calibration.
items.gate: Actual field evidence for hardware/production claims

items.acceptance: Actual Android devices cover interruptions, lock screen, output changes and reconnects.

items.title: Rights and publishing checks
items.scope: Required composition/recording or spoken-work permissions, territory, release window and cache/reward grants.
items.acceptance: Missing uses prevent publishing; revocation does not invent recall of already delivered files.

items.title: Program compiler and completion boundaries
items.scope: Compile content, opening identification, closing identification and before-next-intro reward markers into the common timeline.
items.acceptance: Points closure always follows the full matching outro; opportunities occur before the next intro.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Scheduling, loops and versioned rotations
items.scope: Scheduled shows, recurring blocks, fallback sets and future-effective revisions owned by the broadcaster.
items.acceptance: Continuous station survives publisher disconnection; no user-selectable on-demand track playback.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Interstitial and identification adapters
items.scope: Uploaded/recorded station IDs and deterministic per-content identification metadata, including That was SONG by ARTIST on STATION radio.
items.acceptance: Silent placeholders never count as completed required identification; artist controls actual audio.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Sponsor placement and common-program accounting
items.scope: Broadcaster-approved ads, campaigns and split accounting on one authoritative station sequence.
items.acceptance: No individualized audio ad insertion changes playback timeline; ads do not earn song points.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Always-on encrypted station operations
items.scope: Endpoint prepublication of encrypted audio/programs, autonomous ciphertext scheduler, recovery and fixed approved versions.
items.acceptance: Station keeps broadcasting without artist phone; relay/storage never receives media decryption keys.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Radio join and playback SDK facade
items.scope: Guest live radio, current timeline join, native/web wrappers and backpressure/recovery.
items.acceptance: Tuning in joins current program; supported client types expose honest route/evidence states.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Contribution point policy and units
items.scope: One creator-specific metric: conservative measured acoustic-energy equivalents integrated over qualifying time. Threshold, reference level, safety ceiling and versioned unit fixed in policies.
items.acceptance: No headphone, software-slider or subthreshold credit. Accounted quantity is points, not summed physical decibels.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Independent multi-speaker evidence
items.scope: Deduplicate physical output identities and calibrated source evidence; sum distinct verified output contributions, never a combined field plus its component speakers.
items.acceptance: One output fanned out through multiple clients counts once; unverified 1000-speaker declarations earn nothing.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Realtime provisional point progress
items.scope: Preview per-content points while playback is active; do not create spendable balance yet.
items.acceptance: Preview and settled balances remain distinct; failed evidence windows earn zero.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Outro-complete point vesting
items.scope: Award once per completed broadcast occurrence only after full content and its closing identification; stop, pause, seek, mute or route interruption forfeits provisional cycle. Late join starts eligibility at next full cycle.
items.acceptance: Race/replay and cross-station duplicate-cycle tests vest once; stopping during outro vests zero.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Creator-specific transactional point wallets
items.scope: Append-only earn/spend ledger, fixed-point units, idempotency, persistence, concurrency and creator isolation.
items.acceptance: No transferable universal wallet; spending one artist balance cannot consume another.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Default exponential reward price ladder
items.scope: Slow initial increases that transition into unbounded exponential growth with arbitrary precision, creator overrides and immutable offer-price snapshots.
items.acceptance: High tiers exceed feasible 1000-speaker all-day examples; no floating-point balance overflow or retroactive repricing.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Points reward catalog and atomic redemption
items.scope: Creator-defined points offers, coupons, recordings and other lawful fan rewards; cost/budget/stock and atomic entitlement issuance.
items.acceptance: Concurrent redemption cannot overspend; failed grant restores balance; no paid-single disguise.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Separate Unlocked Groove catalog
items.scope: App-exclusive bonus recordings separated from point offers and paid catalog. Distinct alternate takes have distinct recording IDs.
items.acceptance: The same recording cannot be silently offered in both reward channels; prior entitlements survive edits.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Shared transition opportunity scheduler
items.scope: Broadcaster-defined every x-to-y completed content cadence, one shared timeline opportunity after outro and before next intro.
items.acceptance: One opportunity ID/time reaches all connected clients; joining/reconnecting cannot reroll it.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Exponential rarity and fair eligibility
items.scope: Configurable exponentially decreasing rarity weights, listener lifetime completion gates and seeded auditable server/issuer draws with positive-tail probabilities.
items.acceptance: Superlisteners retain access to rare tiers; rarity does not decrease to zero merely because they listen longer.
items.gate: Software

items.title: Listener completion progress including headphones
items.scope: Recoverable per-creator completed-listen history; headphones are eligible for Grooves and never speaker points.
items.acceptance: Changing output route does not reroll opportunities; muted/background-halted playback is not completion.
